summary.text: Alyssa Brown is a Republican state representative from Arkansas House District 41 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Her career experience includes serving as a ministry director.

paragraphs.text: Brown's career experience includes serving as a ministry director.
She assumed office in the Arkansas House on January 13, 2025, and in the 2025-2026 session was assigned to the House City, County and Local Affairs Committee and the Public Transportation Committee.
